correctness.rationale: For each protected site the strictly diagonally dominant irreducible tridiagonal matrix has a unique globally attracting positive equilibrium. Its inverse first column yields the exact stock/catch fractions in RESULT.md. Directly displayed positive-coefficient polynomials prove strict stock/catch orderings, and the symbolic factorization N01*S-N12*P=m*X*D>0 proves the two threshold weights are universally strictly ordered. The nonadjacent intersection is a strict convex combination, proving the complete five-case optimization diagram. Replaying the standard-library checker verifies five symbolic polynomial equalities, six positivity expansions and 216 exact-rational equilibrium/optimality checks; these finite tests are not substituted for the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The claim is the all-positive-rate and exactly-one-reserve three-way upper-envelope classification for a one-sided recruitment source. De Leenheer 2013 proves a different unrestricted continuum control problem with spatially uniform recruitment; Ding–Lenhart 2009 and Neubert 2003 treat logistic fishery control and yield/cost objectives. The accessible mathematical statements do not imply the present global thresholds. The remaining historical-priority risk is explicitly acknowledged.
residual_risks: Neubert (2003) and Crowder et al. (2000) complete primary texts were not available, leaving a historical-priority risk even though stated models differ.
An unlocated general positive-matrix or Green-function reserve-placement theorem could subsume the three-site phase diagram.
The claim is a strict benchmark only for the stated idealized three-patch model and cannot be extrapolated to unconstrained or nonlinear fishery optimization.

value.rationale: Source-localized recruitment and fixed reserve size are natural source–sink planning constraints. The complete all-positive-rate classification shows all three placements, including the middle site, must each be optimal on a nonempty interval for every admissible rate tuple; this is stronger than one numerical case or merely observing a catch-stock tradeoff. The exact boundaries describe a Pareto decision frontier, a mathematically meaningful finite ecological design result without requiring a downstream theorem or field calibration. The proof is elementary to check but the structural universal three-way switching statement is not a direct textbook substitution into the cited continuous optimal-control results.
